scope: Custom player name in My Profile; no web-game changes.

status.finished: Implemented, signed, installed in place; original save byte-identical before first launch and current-install normal process verified. Core and final targeted UI checks passed.
status.nextWork: Player feedback on rename flow; earlier PR review findings remain separate follow-up work.

behavior.entry: Player → My Profile → pencil beside name
behavior.nameLength: 1–12 extended grapheme clusters after trimming surrounding whitespace
behavior.supported: Chinese, English and visible emoji sequences
behavior.validation: Reject blank names, control characters, invisible fillers and overlong input; do not mutate marked keyboard input.
behavior.commit: Only publish saved display name after repository.save succeeds; keep draft and old name on failure.
behavior.default: Localized Cat parent title when name is absent; custom names remain verbatim across language changes.

limitations: No full historical gameplay suite or iOS 17–25 runtime sweep this release.
Disk-write failure behavior was code-reviewed; name validation and rejected writes were tested in core. No real device disk-full condition was induced.
Earlier PR #3 review findings are outside this feature change and are not marked fixed.
privacy: Raw logs, result bundles, command receipts, device/signing identifiers, local absolute paths and actual saves remain outside the repository. Only compact summaries and selected screenshots are archived.
